# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 1038 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)

- [Unlayer MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/unlayer-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): Unlayer's MCP server for generating and editing email, page and PDF document templates.
- [Padlet MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/padlet-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): Padlet's MCP server for creating and managing boards, posts, comments, sections and sharing settings from an AI assistant.
- [Mintlify MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/mintlify-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): Mintlify's admin MCP server for editing, publishing and managing docs pages, navigation, settings and analytics.
- [Jitsu MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/jitsu-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): Jitsu's MCP server for managing data pipelines: destinations, streams, connections, functions and live events.
- [GTmetrix MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/gtmetrix-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): GTmetrix MCP server for running web performance analyses and getting optimization insights inside AI workflows.
- [Automox MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/automox-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): Official Automox MCP server for managing devices, patches and policies in natural language.
- [Whimsical MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/whimsical-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): Whimsical's MCP server for creating and editing flowcharts, mind maps, wireframes and docs, or searching your workspace.
- [Tenderly MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/tenderly-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): Tenderly's MCP server for blockchain developers to simulate, debug and test transactions on 100+ networks from AI agents.
- [SmartBear MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/smartbear-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): SmartBear's MCP server giving AI tools access to BugSnag, Reflect, Swagger, PactFlow and QTM4J.
- [PandaDoc MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/pandadoc-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): PandaDoc's MCP server for creating, sending, signing and tracking documents from AI assistants.
- [CARTO MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/carto-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): CARTO's MCP server for querying data warehouses, running spatial workflows and rendering maps from your CARTO workspace.
- [Redpanda Docs MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/redpanda-docs-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): Redpanda's MCP server for answering questions from Redpanda documentation and API references.
